svg.title: Industrial electricity prices by U.S. state, August 2026
svg.desc: A choropleth of 50 U.S. states plus Washington DC. Hawaii 39.33, California 24.12, Alaska 23.13, Arizona 9.73, Texas 7.21, New Mexico 5.08 cents per kilowatthour, versus national 9.64. Source: EIA.
